fusions.name: Sleight of Gravel
fusions.desc: Flicks out 3 pebbles at once, spread apart. Each pebble deals 3 damage, with a 20% chance to turn its target against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pulled Rug
fusions.desc: Hurls a boulder that deals 36 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Counterfeit Ward
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Played Dead
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
